sources.citation: Authored measurement contract conventions; Apache-2.0. No external excerpts or reference values are supplied.

nodes.statement: Measurement comparisons require supplied particle level, fiducial scope, normalization, covariance, source revision and uncertainty prescriptions. Contract consistency does not certify scientific applicability.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Born, bare and photon-dressed lepton definitions differ. A dressed definition states its supplied photon radius; prompt-lepton and tau-feed-down rules and fiducial selections are part of the comparison frame.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Absolute, normalized and ratio quantities require different covariance accounting. A normalized distribution has a covariance null direction given by its bin-integration weights; declare the retained rank and either a dropped bin or a pseudoinverse.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Asymmetric marginal errors need an explicit average, maximum or central-shift symmetrization rule. Retain the shift and bin correlations instead of silently discarding them.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Scale envelopes require their complete member census and a separately declared bin correlation and probability model when used as covariance. Retain PDF member ErrorType, confidence rescaling and matching matrix-element and PDF strong coupling. Apply nonperturbative corrections once and compare additive and multiplicative electroweak combinations.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: A seven-point scale prescription includes the central, common and single-scale half or double variations while excluding opposite half/double pairs. A nine-point prescription retains all pairs. An independent prescription states the actual member population and correlations.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Replica, symmetric Hessian and paired Hessian members use their respective uncertainty formulas. State source and target confidence levels and the rescaling model; retain combination prescription and matching strong-coupling variations. PDF impact requires a fitted-data overlap census, tolerance and effective replica accounting.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Declare the electroweak input scheme, additive or multiplicative QCD combination, photon-induced contribution, fixed or running width definition, pole conversion, mixing-angle definition, top mass scheme and quoted mass. Oblique fits require the scalar and top reference masses and scheme.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Hadronization and multiple-parton-interaction correction ratios require supplied numerator and denominator definitions and uncertainty scope. Record whether input tables already include them and apply each correction once.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: A tune requires supplied observable weights, tolerance or eigentune definition and a disjoint held-out observable population. An over-weighted observable can bias the fit; fitted observables do not establish held-out validation.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Regularization, nominal prior and prior variations must be stated. Response closure, distinct stress tests and interval coverage answer different questions; a successful nominal closure does not establish robustness or coverage.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: Measurement combinations must census common datasets, luminosity and systematic sources, declare cross-covariances and state linear-combination assumptions. Zero correlation for shared inputs requires a located justification.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied definitions and prescription records.

nodes.statement: A normalized distribution covariance is singular along its normalization constraint; a full-rank inverse loses that constraint.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.normalized_rule.

nodes.statement: A prediction and data at different particle levels or fiducial definitions compare different quantities.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.frame_declared.

nodes.statement: Marginal errors alone omit supplied bin correlations and cannot replace their covariance.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.covariance_assembled.

nodes.statement: Rescaling a lower-order shape to a different-order rate without a declaration hides the prediction convention.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.prediction_convention.

nodes.statement: A fixed-order prediction outside its supplied low-momentum validity domain need not describe the observable.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.validity_range.

nodes.statement: A routine reference and measurement bundle from different source revisions can disagree after a source correction.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.reference_version.

nodes.statement: A matrix-element strong coupling different from the selected PDF coupling is an inconsistent input prescription.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.alphas_consistent.

nodes.statement: A scale envelope does not itself specify a Gaussian or a bin correlation model.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.prescription_declared.

nodes.statement: Replica and Hessian member populations require different uncertainty formulas and declared confidence rescaling.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.pdf_error_type.

nodes.statement: Applying a nonperturbative correction to inputs that already include it counts the correction twice.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.np_once.

nodes.statement: An electroweak correction combined with QCD without its additive and multiplicative comparison hides combination uncertainty.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.ew_combination.

nodes.statement: A supplied prediction may omit required continuum, loop-induced or interference terms sharing its final state.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.amplitude_complete.

nodes.statement: Impact assessed using data already fitted by the selected PDF set is circular.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.pdf_not_circular.

nodes.statement: Validation on observables used to select a tune is not held-out evidence.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.

obligations.description: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.tune_heldout.

nodes.statement: Combining measurements from a shared dataset or systematic source as independent double counts information.
nodes.applicability: Review against the supplied observable, process, source revision and prescription; no result acceptance is conferred.
